id: \rLenora: I see you made it past my trick. Show me if you have more than intelligence.
en: \rLenora: I see you made it past my trick. Show me if you have more than intelligence.
it: \rAloé: Vedo che hai superato il mio trucco. Mostrami se hai qualcosa in più dell'intelligenza.

id: \rLenora: You have potential, but I feel like you might be missing something. Go speak with my husband upstairs. He will give you something.
en: \rLenora: You have potential, but I feel like you might be missing something. Go speak with my husband upstairs. He will give you something.
it: \rAloé: Hai del potenziale, ma ho l'impressione che ti manchi qualcosa. Va' a parlare con mio marito al piano di sopra. Ti darà una cosa.

id: \rLenora: Come back when you speak with my husband upstairs.
en: \rLenora: Come back when you speak with my husband upstairs.
it: \rAloé: Torna dopo aver parlato con mio marito al piano di sopra.

id: \rLenora: So you got the gift. Maybe you'll put it to use.
en: \rLenora: So you got the gift. Maybe you'll put it to use.
it: \rAloé: Quindi hai ricevuto il regalo. Forse saprai farne buon uso.

id: \rLenora: You've done very well. I admit, you're a talented Trainer. Here, you earned the Basic Badge.
en: \rLenora: You've done very well. I admit, you're a talented Trainer. Here, you earned the Basic Badge.
it: \rAloé: Sei stato davvero bravo. Lo ammetto, sei un Allenatore di talento. Ecco, ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Base.

id: \rTM05 contains Roar. Use it to force your opponent off the field.
en: \rTM05 contains Roar. Use it to force your opponent off the field.
it: \rLa MT05 contiene Boato. Usala per costringere l'avversario a lasciare il campo.

id: \rLenora: Feel free to revive any fossils you find.
en: \rLenora: Feel free to revive any fossils you find.
it: \rAloé: Sentiti libero di far rianimare i fossili che trovi.
